action.action-desc: Mr. Butterfield introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Agriculture, and in addition to the Committees on Financial Services, and Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned

form.official-title: To offer persistent poverty counties and political subdivisions of such counties the opportunity to have their rural development loans restructured.

section.header: Opportunity for persistent poverty counties and political subdivisions in those counties to have their rural development loans restructured

subsection.text: On request of a persistent poverty county or a political subdivision of such a county that has an outstanding loan described in subsection (c), the entity that made the loan shall restructure the loan so that the interest rate on the loan is 0 percent and the loan term is 40 years.

In subsection (a), the term persistent poverty county means a county that has had 20 percent or more of its population living in poverty over the past 30 years, as measured by the 1990, 2000, and 2010 decennial censuses.
A loan is described in this subsection if the loan is any of the following:

paragraph.text: A loan made under section 306(a)(1) of the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act for a water and waste disposal purpose.
A loan made under section 306(a)(1) of the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act for an essential community facility.
A loan made under title III of the Rural Electrification Act of 1936.
A loan made under section 601 of the Rural Electrification Act of 1936.
A loan made under section 2333 of the Food Agriculture, Conservation, and Trade Act of 1990.

paragraph.header: Broadband loan and grant pilot program loan
paragraph.text: A loan made under the program provided for in section 779 of Agriculture, Rural Development, Food and Drug Administration, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2018.
A loan made under any provision of the Rural Electrification Act of 1936 for a rural electrification purpose.
A loan made under section 515 of the Housing Act of 1949 (42 U.S.C. 1485).
